text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki said she was going to practice
dancing
in her new outfit, so I came to
watch her lesson.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You're making me nervous with
how
intensely you're watching me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So she says, but her every step is perfect
and she
finishes the dance with a clean
flourish. She's truly
a captivating sight to
behold.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Hm, I like this outfit. It's nice and
light,
and it makes me feel like I'm
floating in it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? Did I look different
from
usual?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's certainly a different look for her, but
the
elegant colors and dainty
decorations on her new
clothes suit her
perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Thank you! Knowing you think
so highly
of it makes all the work I put
into the design
worth it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Come, Trainer. Let's move to a new
venue. I get
the feeling others will want
to use this room soon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I ask her where we should go, Fuji
Kiseki
merely winks at me and says it's a
secret. I follow
her to...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Aha. I knew it'd be too early for anyone
to be
here yet.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
May I have this dance? Just one. If you'll
agree to
take my hand...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I promise to fill your ears and heart with
the most
stupendous music ever.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It'll be a dance you'll never forget. I
guarantee it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Good! Then, shall we begin?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki whisks me off, and we begin
to dance
together.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're doing great, Trainer. Just relax
and follow
my lead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She flashes me a warm smile, and I return
it. The
only music we're dancing to is the
mad drumming
beat of our own racing
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm stumbling gracelessly like an
uncoordinated
fawn, but like magic, Fuji
Kiseki transforms each
of my blunders
into a perfect step.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! That was so much fun. Let's take
a break
and then dance again, hm?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Are you wondering why I asked you to
dance all
of a sudden? The truth is, I've
wanted to ask you
since ages ago.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Do you know about the Ligne Droite?
It's a dance
party held in celebration of
the new year.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who participate in it
dress up as
beautifully as bouquets of
fresh flowers and
dance their hearts out!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course! ...Which brings us back to
now.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The Ligne Droite gives me the chance to
dance
with my darling ponies, but it
doesn't grant me
the same opportunity
to dance with you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's not only my dear ponies that I want
to bring
joy to, but you and others as
well.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to focus on any single
person. I want
to light up the lives of all
those who are within the
range of my
embrace.

text_block_list.name: Female Patient
text_block_list.text:
So even I still have the ability to make
others
happy...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It might be wishful thinking, but if I
reach out to
someone and they take my
hand and smile, then
maybe...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just maybe... that person will reach out
to others
in the hopes of making them
happy too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That's the wish I imbued in this outfit.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I hope to be like a star in the sky—and
their
smiles like roses in continuous
bloom under the
warm and bright light
of my shining star.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No matter what road people are
walking, I want
them to be able to find
that light.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That's right.
choice_data_list: 差し伸べる手のように……

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No matter how small a pinprick that light
may be,
so long as its faintest twinkle
reaches them, they
can find it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That would truly be a miracle, don't you
think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel as if I've already been bestowed
the miracle
that Fuji Kiseki is speaking
of.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: 1人は確実に笑顔になったよ

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! That's where you're wrong. It's not
just one
person who's smiling—it's two!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now what do you say to having another
dance so
we can keep these smiles
going?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We get back into position, grasp each
other's
hands, and exchange smiles. Fuji
Kiseki's grin is
softer than normal,
beautiful like a sixth
magnitude star.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I hope I can make people happy, no
matter where
they are or how difficult
their circumstances may
be.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: フジキセキならできるよ

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! That means the absolute
world to me!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to invest everything I've got into
my
concerts as well as my races if I want
to live up to
your words.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now... May I have this dance?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I nod grateful acceptance and place my
palm into
her proffered hand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki bursts into laughter and spins
me
around on even lighter and brighter
steps than
the first time around.
